hero.title: Undergraduate Computer Engineering in Spain for Indian Students
hero.subtitle: Earn a 4-year Grado in Computer Engineering in Spain across dynamic tech hubs in Barcelona and Madrid, mastering digital electronics, embedded microcontrollers, and 12-month post-study job search authorization.

overview: Spain offers a vibrant, modern engineering education system fully compliant with the European Bologna Process, with expanding microelectronics, telecommunications, and robotics clusters in Madrid, Barcelona, and Valencia. Studying undergraduate Computer Engineering in Spain provides Indian students with comprehensive training in hardware design and digital systems engineering.

Spanish public and private universities deliver 4-year Bachelor's degrees (*Grado en Ingeniería Informática / Computadores*, 240 ECTS). The academic program covers digital electronics, computer organization, microprocessor interfacing, embedded systems, and networks, providing extensive laboratory practice and industry capstone internships at competitive annual tuition rates (€1,500 to €6,500/year).

International graduates in Spain can apply for a 12-month non-renewable post-study residence permit for job seeking or entrepreneurship (*Permiso de Residencia para Búsqueda de Empleo*, Law 14/2013 / EU Directive 2016/801). This permit enables qualifying Level 6 graduates to transition smoothly into skilled employment as Hardware Test Engineers, Firmware Developers, and Systems Engineers across Spain's digital engineering sector.

sections.lead: Studying Computer Engineering in Spain is a great choice for Indian students who want to gain a strong base in computing, engineering principles, software systems, and cutting-edge technologies.

items: European Education: Learn about the Spanish higher education system and experience international academic exposure.
Technical Curriculum: Discover programming, algorithms, computer architecture, operating systems, and database management.
Emerging Technologies: Discover artificial intelligence, robotics, cloud computing, cybersecurity, and the Internet of Things.
Practical Learning: Acquire technical abilities via lab work, projects, assignments, and internships where available.
International Experience: Experience a multicultural academic environment with the opportunity to study across Europe.
Career Opportunities: Prepare for a career in software development, networking, computer systems, information security, and technology research.
Postgraduate Study: After your bachelor's degree, go on to a related master's degree or a specialized program in computing.

sections.title: Fees for Computer Engineering in Spain
sections.lead: If you are looking to plan the overall cost of an undergraduate degree, then it is important to understand Computer Engineering Fees in Spain. Tuition fees differ by university, region, program and international student fee category.

items: University typeExample annual tuitionApprox. INR per annum
Public university€1,000 - €8,000₹1.09 - ₹8.69 lakh
Private university€6,000–€20,000+₹6.52–₹21.72 lakh+
These are planning level estimates. Actual fees may vary considerably especially for non EU students. Please confirm the fee for your particular program and intake.
Illustration of College Tuition Rates
Polytechnic University of Catalonia (UPC): Lists approximate annual tuition of €1,800 for non-EU students who are not EU residents for its bachelor's degree in Informatics Engineering.
Pompeu Fabra University (UPF): Has an approximate price of €6,800.32 for non-EU students or non-residents for its bachelor's degree in Computer Engineering .

Students should budget separately for accommodation, food, transport, health insurance, books, visa expenses and personal costs. Scholarships or reduced fees may be available depending on eligibility and funding.

sections.title: Recognition of degrees in Computer Science in Spain
sections.lead: Indian students should ensure that the program they choose will meet their educational and career goals before applying.

items: Important considerations:
If the university and degree are officially recognized in Spain.
In case it is an official university bachelor degree.
Whether the program prepares you for admission to the master's degree you might want to do afterward.
If the curriculum covers relevant programming, computing, systems and engineering subjects.
If you wish to gain further professional recognition for the role you are planning to take up in your destination country.
For example, the bachelor's degree in Informatics Engineering at UPC is included in the official list of degrees of the university register of Spain.

The licensing requirements for computer engineering jobs aren't all the same. However, if you plan to undertake a regulated role or further study in India or overseas, you should confirm the relevant recognition requirements with the relevant institution or authority.

faqs.q: Can Indian students study Computer Engineering in Spain after 12th?
faqs.a: Yeah. Indian students can apply after class 12, if they fulfilll the requirements of academics, qualification recognition, language and university admission.

faqs.q: How long does a Bachelor's Degree in Computer Engineering last in Spain?
faqs.a: Most bachelor programs are four years long and worth 240 ECTS credits. The length varies based on university and degree structure.

faqs.q: Can I study Computer Engineering in English in Spain?
faqs.a: Yes. Some programs offer study groups in English. For example, Pompeu Fabra University has a program in which the entire degree in Computer Engineering can be studied in English. Other universities may teach some subjects in Spanish, Catalan or a combination of languages.

faqs.q: What is the computer engineering fees in Spain for Indian students?
faqs.a: Public universities may cost around €1,000-€8,000 per year (broad planning estimates) while private universities may charge more. The actual fees depend on the university, the student category and the academic year.

Graduates may go on to work in software development, computer systems, networking, cybersecurity, cloud computing, data engineering, and embedded systems. Additional experience or post graduate qualifications may be required for higher level roles.
